name: card-tabs
title: Card tabs
description: Tabs whose triggers are cards with an icon, a title and a line, for choosing between jobs, plans or modes, with real tabpanels and 2D arrow keys.
docs: Pass tabs (value, title, description, icon, count, disabled), value and onValueChange (or defaultValue), and CardTabsContent panels as children, one per value. orientation="horizontal" is a grid of columns cards per row from the sm breakpoint (default the number of tabs, at most 3) and a single column on a phone; "vertical" is a list beside the panel from md up. The selected card has a stronger border and an inverted icon tile, which read without colour. They are real tabs, and a card is named by what it shows (title, count and line), so what someone sees is what a voice command or a screen reader says; arrow keys move and select, and Up and Down also move by a whole row, measured from the layout as it is right now, so a phone's single column steps one card at a time. icon is an element, so pass <IconRocket />. The count is written with locale. The selected panel is a tab stop, so it shows a focus ring when the keyboard reaches it.
